wallets.name: Aadhaar App
wallets.description:
The Aadhaar App is an identity credential wallet that enables users to securely store, access and present Aadhaar-based identity credentials to prove their identity across online and offline scenarios. As of 26 August 2026, the app has 52 million downloads, with 202 relying parties integrated and approximately 300,000 verifiable credential presentations taking place each month.

The wallet is being used across a growing range of use cases, including identity verification for national examinations, gig-economy platforms such as Urban Company and Hala Mobility, customer and partner verification, and social media profile verification. Going forward, the vision is to extend the wallet beyond identity and enable other welfare and government credentials to be embedded into the same user-controlled digital wallet.
features: web-to-app and QR-based cross-device credential sharing
offline face verification with liveness detection
multi-profile support with multi-factor credential download

wallets.name: Credenco Wallet
wallets.description:
The Credenco Wallet enables users to securely receive, store, manage, and present verifiable credentials and digital identity information. Built with privacy and security in mind, the wallet supports trusted interactions with participating relying parties while keeping users in control of their personal data.

Key features include:
- Securely receive and store verifiable credentials
- Manage digital identity information on-device
- Present credentials securely to trusted relying parties
- Privacy-preserving sharing with user consent
- Support for interoperable European digital identity standards

The Credenco Wallet also provides the ability to receive and share credentials from your Credenco Business Wallet.

wallets.name: France Identité
wallets.description: France Identité app launched by French Ministry of Interior entered beta in May 2022 before full public rollout February 14, 2024, with no user limits, enabling citizens to create dematerialized versions of identity cards and driving licenses on smartphones using NFC readers to scan biometric identity cards requiring Android 11 or iOS 16 minimum software. The state-provided digital identity platform generates electronically signed proofs of identity to prevent fraud, authenticates users for FranceConnect government services access, and displays identity cards and Carte Vitale health insurance cards, with plans to expand health card functionality in 2025, positioning France among early adopters of EUDI Wallet-compatible infrastructure preparing for EU Digital Identity Wallet framework implementation by 2030 for uniform mobile driving licenses across Europe aligned with eIDAS 2.0 regulation.

wallets.name: Heidi Wallet App
wallets.description:
Heidi Wallet is the easy-to-use wallet app. Built on open protocols, Heidi Wallet interacts with a range of issuers and verifiers. It is compatible with both the EUDI Wallet ecosystem and Switzerland’s swiyu trust infrastructure, supporting a broad range of use cases.

The app goes beyond credential issuance and presentation. It supports zero-knowledge proofs based on BBS+, and lets users sign digital documents directly within the wallet, exploring what digital identity wallets can do beyond their core use cases.

wallets.name: IT Wallet
wallets.description: Italy’s IT-Wallet is a national digital wallet system integrated into the IO app. Launched nationwide in December 2024, it enables citizens to store and present digital versions of official documents, including driving licences, health cards and the European Disability Card. The system is being further developed in alignment with the European Digital Identity Wallet framework, with additional credentials and services planned.

wallets.name: Sphereon Business Wallet
wallets.description:
The Sphereon business wallet is an enterprise-grade, API-first application service that provides the comprehensive functionality required to manage the complete digital credential lifecycle. It enables organizations to seamlessly operate as issuers, holders, and verifiers of verifiable credentials. Designed for ecosystem interoperability, it supports cross-border European standards including eIDAS 2.0 profiles, SD-JWT, and ISO 18013-5 mdocs. Its headless architecture allows it to integrate silently into existing ERP, GRC, and procurement workflows, allowing organizations to automate compliance and trust without forcing employees to adopt new standalone interfaces.

What distinguishes the Sphereon business wallet from standard digital identity applications is its underlying Sphereon Verifiable Data Exchange (VDX) trust engine. While most wallets passively hold or perform basic checks on credentials, the Sphereon wallet actively gates business operations.

This allows organizations to create an authoritative semantic model of their specific operational world. Using integrated industry-standard decision engines, the wallet evaluates every single action and credential exchange against internal organizational policies, external regulations, and technical specifications.

The result is that every data exchange produces a definitive outcome ( Permit, Deny, or Step-Up) that dictates subsequent workflow steps. Furthermore, instead of relying on standard system logs, every decision and its surrounding context is cryptographically written to a tamper-proof, hash-chained audit trail. The Sphereon business wallet does not just verify data; it provides a legally defensible, perfectly reconstructable record of continuous assurance for every operational decision.

wallets.name: Sphereon VDX platform
wallets.description:
Sphereon VDX is a verifiable data layer for policy-driven trust and audit-ready decisions. It is a deployable verifiable data exchange platform that verifies evidence, resolves trust, applies policy, and returns auditable decisions to your existing business systems.

It is an omni-channel enterprise developer platform supporting management of organizational wallets, mobile wallets and identity integrations, providing holder, issuer, and verifier capabilities with DIIP v5, HAIP and OID4VCI/VP 1.0, ISO-18013-5/7 compliance.

Where our open-source Sphereon Identity Development Kit (IDK) provides low-level cryptographic control and our Sphereon Enterprise development Kit (EDK) provides production-grade building blocks, the Sphereon Verifiable data Exchange (VDX) platform provides the deployable verifiable data layer with APIs, management tooling, workflow support, and reusable solution patterns for enterprise operations.

See our developer documentation for all details or contact us for a free consultation

wallets.name: VS Agent - Verana Business Wallet
wallets.description:
VS Agent is the reference implementation of a Verifiable Service: an open-source, self-hosted business wallet that gives every service an organization operates a verifiable identity, so anyone can check what it is and who runs it before connecting.

Its DID plugs into the Verana Network, a public decentralized trust infrastructure that no vendor or state controls: join any ecosystem as issuer, verifier or holder, with no platform account and no gatekeeper. Each ecosystem defines its own onboarding process (registry lookup, accreditation, eIDAS-grade KYB if required) and its own privacy-preserving business model: onboarding, pay-per-issuance and pay-per-verification fees settled on-chain, without tracking users. The credential lifecycle is automatic via the vt-flow protocol: onboarding triggers issuance, on-chain revocation reaches the holder.

DIDComm and OpenID4VCI/VP; JSON-LD, AnonCreds and SD-JWT VC. Host chat agents, MCP servers, A2A agents or HTTP APIs under one DID. Apache-2.0.
wallets.pricing:
The wallet is free and always will be. VS Agent is the reference implementation of a Verifiable Service, published under the Apache-2.0 license and stewarded as part of the Verana Foundation's mission: trust infrastructure only works if anyone can inspect it, run it and build on it without asking permission. No license fee, no usage tier, no hosted lock-in: you self-host the container and keep full control of your keys, data and DID.

There is no software vendor to pay; value flows between ecosystem participants instead. You pay your own hosting, the network fees of the Verana Verifiable Public Registry, and the fees each ecosystem defines for its privacy-preserving business models: onboarding, pay-per-issuance and pay-per-verification, settled on-chain, backed by reclaimable trust deposits, and charged without tracking users or monetizing their data. Commercial support and integration services are available from Verana Labs and ecosystem partners.
